title: The effect of job loss on labor supply, wealth, and spousal labor supply for older workers
title_primary: The effect of job loss on labor supply, wealth, and spousal labor supply for older workers
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I study the effect of job loss due to mass layoffs on labor supply, wealth, and spousal labor supply among older workers using high-quality Danish administrative data. Job loss reduces labor earnings, disposable income, and employment across all ages, but short-run losses are largest for older workers. Displaced workers aged 60 to 64 earn 32% less one year after displacement compared to similar non-displaced workers and are more likely to retire and less likely to be homeowners. Job loss also affects partners. While younger partners increase labor supply, older partners are more likely to retire.

title: The Anatomy and Evolution of Survey Error
title_zh: 调查误差的解剖与演变
title_primary: 调查误差的解剖与演变
title_secondary: The Anatomy and Evolution of Survey Error
authors: Bruce D. Meyer, Nikolas Mittag, Derek Wu, Anthony Tatarka, Patrick Langetieg
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Surveys provide much of what we know in social science and are often the only source of information on private behaviors, attitudes and expectations. Strands of the literature document four broad error sources: survey coverage, unit non-response, item non-response, and measurement error. Yet the absence of comparable error measures across sources and over time has left the relative severity of error sources difficult to assess, limiting efforts by survey producers to improve accuracy and users to interpret survey statistics. We unify the fragmented literature by analyzing and decomposing survey error in an empirical Total Survey Error (TSE) framework, quantifying for the first time every error component on a common scale of bias and absolute error. We apply our approach to comprehensively measure survey error in eighteen income and program receipt variables from the CPS ASEC – one of the oldest and most rigorously tested surveys, and the official source of income and poverty statistics in the U.S. – using linked administrative records over more than two decades. For nearly half of the variables, bias exceeds 40 percent and eliminating all individual-level error would require changing more than 80 percent of the true total. Contrary to the conventional emphasis on non-response, we find that the dominant source of bias is measurement error among respondents who fail to report receipt (false negatives). The largest potential gains therefore come from improving the accuracy of respondent reporting rather than raising response rates. This underreporting also propagates into imputed values for non-respondents, which are drawn from (misreported) responses and are particularly noisy, with positive and negative errors that tend to offset in net terms. Moreover, net bias can be an incomplete guide to data quality, as we find that absolute error has tended to rise over time even when net bias is stable. Overall, our approach provides a new method for measuring and decomposing survey error, clarifying which sources of bias require user corrections and where survey design improvements could be most consequential.
abstract_zh: 调查问卷提供了社会科学中我们所知的大部分内容，并且往往是关于私人行为、态度和期望的唯一信息来源。文献中的多个分支记录了四大类错误来源：调查覆盖范围、单位无回应、项目无回应以及测量误差。然而，由于缺乏跨来源和跨时间的可比误差度量，错误来源的相对严重性难以评估，限制了调查生产者提高准确性和使用者解读调查统计数据的努力。我们通过在一个实证总调查误差（TSE）框架中分析和分解调查误差，统一了分散的文献，首次以偏差和绝对误差的通用尺度量化了每一个误差组成部分。我们将此方法应用于全面测量来自CPS ASEC——这一历史最悠久、测试最严格的调查之一，也是美国官方收入与贫困统计来源——的十八个收入及项目领取变量中的调查误差，使用了超过二十年的关联行政记录。对于近一半的变量，偏差超过40%，而消除所有个体层面误差将需要改变超过80%的真实总量。与对无回应的传统强调相反，我们发现偏差的主要来源是未能报告领取（假阴性）的受访者中的测量误差。因此，最大的潜在改进来自于提高受访者报告的准确性，而非提高回应率。这种漏报也传播到无回应者的插补值中，这些值来源于（误报的）回应，且特别嘈杂，正负误差往往在净额上相互抵消。此外，净偏差可能不是数据质量的完整指南，因为我们发现即使净偏差稳定，绝对误差也往往随时间上升。总体而言，我们的方法提供了一种新的测量和分解调查误差的手段，阐明了哪些偏差来源需要使用者修正，以及调查设计改进可能在哪里产生最大影响。

title: What drives the volatility of professional stock return forecasts? Causal evidence from macro shocks
title_zh: 宏观经济冲击对专业股票收益预测波动性的因果影响
title_primary: 宏观经济冲击对专业股票收益预测波动性的因果影响
title_secondary: What drives the volatility of professional stock return forecasts? Causal evidence from macro shocks
authors: Martijn Boons, Giorgio Ottonello, Rossen Valkanov
official: 官方在线 2026-08-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Consensus professional stock return forecasts are three times more volatile than those of non-professionals and econometricians. We show that this difference reflects professionals’ strong countercyclical responses to macro shocks, which explain 20–40% of forecast variation and are consistent with rational asset pricing models in which discount rates rise in bad times. We use macro shocks to identify the discount-rate component of professional forecasts and find that it closely matches realized returns. We conclude that professionals’ assessment of the discount-rate impact of macro shocks distinguishes them from other forecasts, challenging existing models of expectation formation.
abstract_zh: 共识性专业股票收益预测的波动性是非专业人士和计量经济学家的三倍。我们表明，这一差异反映了专业人士对宏观冲击的强烈逆周期反应，这些反应解释了预测变异的20%-40%，并与理性资产定价模型一致，即折现率在经济不景气时上升。我们利用宏观冲击来识别专业预测中的折现率成分，并发现其与实际回报紧密匹配。我们得出结论，专业人士对宏观冲击折现率影响的评估使其区别于其他预测，这对现有的预期形成模型提出了挑战。

title: Providers, Places, and Children’s Mental Health Care
title_zh: 医疗服务提供者、场所与儿童心理健康照护
title_primary: 医疗服务提供者、场所与儿童心理健康照护
title_secondary: Providers, Places, and Children’s Mental Health Care
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract Children’s mental health is the defining public health crisis of our time. Using the largest repository of private insurance claims in the United States, I provide the first systematic quantification of the variation in children’s mental health prescribing in the U.S. I separate variation due to 1) primary care provider (PCP) prescribing intensities, 2) regional practice environments, and 3) child health and demand. Equalizing PCP intensities would reduce the variance of provider prescribing rates by 50 percent for ADHD and 65 percent for antidepressants. Analyzing geographic variation alone significantly understates the extent of treatment variation and the role of providers.
abstract_zh: 摘要 儿童心理健康是我们时代决定性的公共卫生危机。利用美国最大的私人保险索赔数据库，我首次系统量化了美国儿童心理健康处方开具的变异情况。我将变异来源区分为：1）初级保健提供者（PCP）的处方强度，2）区域实践环境，以及3）儿童健康与需求。若使PCP处方强度均等化，注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的提供者处方率方差将减少50%，抗抑郁药则减少65%。仅分析地理变异会显著低估治疗变异程度及提供者的作用。

title: Factor distortions and carbon efficiency: the case of energy misallocation
title_zh: 要素扭曲与碳效率：能源错配的案例研究
title_primary: 要素扭曲与碳效率：能源错配的案例研究
title_secondary: Factor distortions and carbon efficiency: the case of energy misallocation
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The enhancement of carbon productivity necessitates the deployment of cleaner technologies, the establishment of robust policy frameworks, and the optimization of production factor allocation. This study examines the effect of energy misallocation on total factor carbon productivity (TFCP) using stochastic frontier analysis across 73 countries. Employing panel data from 1991 to 2023, we construct country-level relative misallocation indices for energy, capital, and labour, based on deviations between observed and theoretically efficient factor input shares. Our methodology involves fixed-effects models and several robustness checks, including dynamic panel analysis and policy-heterogeneity tests. The results reveal a strong negative correlation between energy misallocation and TFCP, whereas the impacts of capital and labour misallocation are comparatively weaker and less consistent. Energy over-allocation imposes a greater productivity cost than under-allocation, indicating that excessive energy consumption significantly impedes carbon-adjusted efficiency. This deleterious effect intensifies in later periods, coinciding with increases in economic scale, energy demand, and carbon constraints. Nevertheless, policy-heterogeneity tests, utilizing Environmental Policy Stringency indicators, demonstrate that environmental policies, particularly market-based instruments, partially attenuate this effect by strengthening price signals and incentivizing structural adjustments. These findings highlight energy allocation efficiency as a critical mechanism through which low-carbon transition policies can advance carbon productivity. KEYWORDS: Energy misallocation total factor carbon productivity resource distortion environmental regulation climate policy JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q43 Q54 O47 D24
abstract_zh: 提升碳生产率需要部署清洁技术、建立稳健的政策框架并优化生产要素配置。本研究运用随机前沿分析法，考察了73个国家能源错配对全要素碳生产率（TFCP）的影响。基于1991至2023年的面板数据，我们根据实际要素投入份额与理论有效份额的偏离程度，构建了国家层面的能源、资本和劳动力相对错配指数。研究方法包括固定效应模型及多项稳健性检验，如动态面板分析和政策异质性检验。结果表明，能源错配与全要素碳生产率呈显著负相关，而资本和劳动力错配的影响则相对较弱且一致性较差。能源过度配置比配置不足造成的生产率损失更大，表明能源过度消耗显著阻碍了碳调整效率。这种负面效应在后期阶段加剧，与经济规模、能源需求和碳约束的增加同步。然而，利用环境政策严格度指标进行的政策异质性检验表明，环境政策（尤其是市场型工具）通过强化价格信号和激励结构调整，部分缓解了这一效应。这些发现揭示了能源配置效率是低碳转型政策提升碳生产率的关键机制。关键词：能源错配 全要素碳生产率 资源扭曲 环境规制 气候政策 JEL分类：Q43 Q54 O47 D24

title: Asymptotics of CoVaR inference in two-quantile-regression
title_zh: 两分位数回归中CoVaR推断的渐近性质
title_primary: 两分位数回归中CoVaR推断的渐近性质
title_secondary: Asymptotics of CoVaR inference in two-quantile-regression
authors: Xuan Leng, Yi He, Yanxi Hou, Liang Peng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Measuring systemic risk has been an important topic in recent research on risk management. Adrian and Brunnermeier (2016) pioneered the CoVaR measure for systemic risk, which is defined as the conditional quantile of system loss given some state predictors and one stress event of an individual loss at a certain risk level. They proposed to estimate CoVaR by a two-quantile-regression approach, which is simple and easy to implement in practice, but without stating or developing the necessary asymptotic theory. In this paper, we develop tests to reveal that using the classical regularity condition in quantile regressions for the two-quantile-regression model may be unrealistic by revisiting the datasets in Adrian and Brunnermeier (2016). Under the proposed weaker conditions, we further develop the asymptotic theory of the CoVaR inference and introduce a random weighted bootstrap method to quantify the inference uncertainty. We examine the finite sample performance of the proposed tests in terms of size and power, as well as the coverage probabilities of confidence intervals for CoVaR. Finally, we demonstrate the CoVaR inference across financial institutions and time.
abstract_zh: 衡量系统性风险一直是风险管理近期研究中的重要课题。Adrian和Brunnermeier（2016）开创性地提出了用于系统性风险的CoVaR度量，该度量定义为在给定某些状态预测因子和单个损失在特定风险水平下的压力事件条件下，系统损失的條件分位数。他们提出通过双分位数回归方法估计CoVaR，该方法在实践中简单易行，但未阐述或发展必要的渐近理论。本文通过重新审视Adrian和Brunnermeier（2016）的数据集，开发了检验方法，以揭示在双分位数回归模型中使用经典分位数回归正则条件可能不切实际。在提出的较弱条件下，我们进一步发展了CoVaR推断的渐近理论，并引入随机加权自助法来量化推断不确定性。我们检验了所提检验在规模和功效方面的有限样本性能，以及CoVaR置信区间的覆盖概率。最后，我们展示了跨金融机构和时间的CoVaR推断。

title: Difference-in-Differences Estimators of Intertemporal Treatment Effects
title_zh: 跨期处理效应的双重差分估计量
title_primary: 跨期处理效应的双重差分估计量
title_secondary: Difference-in-Differences Estimators of Intertemporal Treatment Effects
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study treatment-effect estimation using panel data. The treatment may be nonbinary, nonabsorbing, and the outcome may be affected by treatment lags. We make a parallel-trends assumption and propose event-study estimators of the effect of being exposed to a weakly higher treatment dose for ℓ periods. We also propose normalized estimators that estimate a weighted average of the effects of the current treatment and its lags. We also analyze commonly used two-way, fixed-effects regressions. Unlike our estimators, they can be biased in the presence of heterogeneous treatment effects. A local-projection version of those regressions is biased even with homogeneous effects.
abstract_zh: 本文利用面板数据研究处理效应估计。处理变量可能为非二元、非吸收性，且结果可能受到处理滞后期的影响。我们基于平行趋势假设，提出事件研究估计量，用于估计暴露于弱更高处理剂量持续ℓ期的效应。同时，我们提出标准化估计量，以估计当前处理效应及其滞后效应的加权平均值。此外，我们分析了常用的双向固定效应回归模型。与我们的估计量不同，这些模型在存在异质性处理效应时可能产生偏误。即使处理效应具有同质性，这些回归的局部投影版本仍存在偏误。

title: Adjustable Product Attributes, Indirect Network Effects, and Subsidy Design: The Case of Electric Vehicles
title_zh: 可调整产品属性、间接网络效应与补贴设计：以电动汽车为例
title_primary: 可调整产品属性、间接网络效应与补贴设计：以电动汽车为例
title_secondary: Adjustable Product Attributes, Indirect Network Effects, and Subsidy Design: The Case of Electric Vehicles
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a structural model of endogenous product attribute choice in the presence of indirect network effects to study electric vehicle (EV) subsidies. Using data on the German EV market, I find that a support scheme almost doubled EV sales but substantially affected EVs’ price and driving range. These adjustments create a trade-off between optimizing different policy objectives when designing subsidies. Large purchase subsidies maximize EV sales, whereas large charging station subsidies maximize consumer and total surplus. The results suggest that maximizing EV sales can lead to unintended consequences in the form of price and range adjustments. (JEL D12, D22, D85, H25, L14, L62, R41)
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个存在间接网络效应时内生产品属性选择的结构模型，用以研究电动汽车补贴政策。基于德国电动汽车市场数据，我发现补贴计划使电动汽车销量几乎翻倍，但显著影响了其价格与续航里程。这些调整在设计补贴时形成了不同政策目标之间的权衡：高额购车补贴能最大化电动汽车销量，而高额充电站补贴则能最大化消费者剩余与总剩余。研究结果表明，追求销量最大化可能导致价格与续航里程调整等非预期后果。（JEL分类号：D12, D22, D85, H25, L14, L62, R41）

title: Risky (Natural) Assets: Stochasticity, Nonconvexity, and the Value of Natural Capital
title_zh: 风险性（自然）资产：随机性、非凸性与自然资本价值
title_primary: 风险性（自然）资产：随机性、非凸性与自然资本价值
title_secondary: Risky (Natural) Assets: Stochasticity, Nonconvexity, and the Value of Natural Capital
authors: Joshua K. Abbott, Eli P. Fenichel, Seong Do Yun
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-04-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: There is renewed interest in valuing the natural assets that sustain human welfare and economic prosperity. The science associated with many renewable natural asset stocks often highlights risk, uncertainty, and tipping points (nonconvexities). However, there is little guidance in the literature concerning how to incorporate risk or tipping points within capital dynamics into the valuation of nonmarket assets. We extend and demonstrate the theory of natural capital valuation for smooth stochasticity (diffusions) with convex and nonconvex drift terms and for “stochastic nonconvexities,” whereby a stock is subject to endogenous risk of collapse. We highlight pathways for risk to influence capital valuations, demonstrating conditions where diffusions with convex dynamics have negligible effects on shadow prices. However, we find that risk has large stock-dependent effects in the context of nonconvexities. Our findings suggest that efforts to incorporate risk into natural capital valuation should prioritize settings where nonconvex capital dynamics are likely.
abstract_zh: 近年来，人们重新关注对支撑人类福祉和经济繁荣的自然资产的估值问题。与许多可再生自然资产存量相关的科学往往强调风险、不确定性和临界点（非凸性）。然而，文献中关于如何将资本动态中的风险或临界点纳入非市场资产估值的指导甚少。我们扩展并展示了自然资本估值理论，涵盖具有凸和非凸漂移项的平滑随机性（扩散过程），以及“随机非凸性”，即存量面临内生性崩溃风险的情形。我们强调了风险影响资本估值的途径，证明了在凸动态扩散条件下风险对影子价格的影响可忽略不计的条件。然而，我们发现，在非凸性背景下，风险具有显著的存量依赖效应。我们的研究结果表明，将风险纳入自然资本估值的努力应优先考虑非凸资本动态可能出现的场景。

title: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies in the Transition to Clean Technology
title_zh: 清洁技术转型中的自我实现预言
title_primary: 清洁技术转型中的自我实现预言
title_secondary: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies in the Transition to Clean Technology
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Technological lock-in has been a standard explanation for the slow take-off of clean innovation, but is hard to reconcile with forward-looking investors who anticipate the eventual switch to clean technologies. We provide an alternative explanation: strategic investment complementarities shape innovation and self-fulfilling prophecies can lead to delayed low-carbon transition. We analyze a standard directed technical change model with clean and dirty inputs. Under good input substitutability, two stable steady states co-exist, each allowing multiple transitional paths. Optimal low-carbon transition requires a Pigouvian tax rule combined with a coordination device; commitment to a Pigouvian tax trajectory cannot solve a coordination failure. (JEL H23, O31, O33, O44, Q54, Q55)
abstract_zh: 技术锁定一直是解释清洁创新起步缓慢的标准理论，但这一观点难以与预期最终将转向清洁技术的具有前瞻性的投资者相协调。我们提出另一种解释：战略性投资互补性塑造了创新过程，而自我实现的预言可能导致低碳转型延迟。我们分析了一个包含清洁与污染投入的标准定向技术变革模型。在投入品替代性良好的条件下，两个稳定稳态并存，每个稳态均允许多条转型路径。最优低碳转型需要将庇古税规则与协调机制相结合；而承诺实施庇古税轨迹无法解决协调失灵问题。(JEL H23, O31, O33, O44, Q54, Q55)

title: Maternity leave and labour market outcomes
title_zh: 产假与劳动力市场结果
title_primary: 产假与劳动力市场结果
title_secondary: Maternity leave and labour market outcomes
authors: Purna Banerjee, Shreya Biswas, Debojyoti Mazumder
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using a triple difference estimation strategy, we compare the labour market outcomes of men and women before and just after the implementation of extended maternity leave policy across age profiles of individuals, in India. We find a negative impact of the maternity leave extension policy on the employment of women in high-fertility age cohorts. To explain this intuitively, we adapt a stylized micro-founded model of life-cycle search and matching friction in a gendered environment where the additional cost burden of maternity leave is borne by the firms, as is the case in India. We argue that if the firm’s cost from longer maternity leave duration outweighs the gain from retaining a worker, then the probability of being employed for fertile-age female workers decreases; via increased reservation productivity and decreased market tightness. Our empirical results and theoretical framework underscore the fact that even a well-intended policy design must be cognizant of underlying labour market dynamics to avoid exacerbating gender differences in labour markets.
abstract_zh: 采用三重差分估计策略，我们比较了印度实施延长产假政策前后，不同年龄段个体的男女劳动力市场结果。我们发现，延长产假政策对高生育年龄段女性的就业产生了负面影响。为直观解释这一现象，我们构建了一个基于生命周期搜索与匹配摩擦的微观基础模型，并置于性别化环境中，其中产假带来的额外成本负担由企业承担，正如印度的情况。我们认为，如果企业因延长产假而承担的成本超过保留员工的收益，那么育龄女性工人的就业概率将下降；这通过提高保留生产率和降低市场紧密度实现。我们的实证结果和理论框架强调，即使是意图良好的政策设计，也必须认识到潜在的劳动力市场动态，以避免加剧劳动力市场中的性别差异。

title_zh: 稳定币与宏观经济稳定性：一项DSGE研究

authors: Hui He & Yao Zhao & Dayong Zhou
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The paper develops a new monetarist DSGE model to examine the macroeconomic implications of fiat-money-backed stablecoins and the effectiveness of prudential policies in mitigating associated risks. The model features two segmented sectors: a centralized real economy where fiat money facilitates consumption and investment, and a decentralized virtual economy characterized by anonymous bilateral search and matching, in which transactions are exclusively conducted using stablecoins. Calibrated to the U.S. economy, the simulation results reveal that stablecoins amplify the propagation of exogenous shocks to key macroeconomic variables by weakening the effectiveness of monetary policy. However, prudential regulations—specifically those governing the backing ratio of stablecoins to fiat-denominated reserve assets, analogous to banking liquidity requirements—can serve as stabilizing instruments, dampening volatility and enhancing macroeconomic resilience in the presence of stablecoins.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新型货币主义DSGE模型，以研究由法定货币支持的稳定币的宏观经济影响，以及审慎政策在缓解相关风险方面的有效性。该模型包含两个分割的部门：一个集中的实体经济部门，其中法定货币促进消费和投资；一个去中心化的虚拟经济部门，其特征是匿名双边搜索与匹配，交易仅使用稳定币进行。基于美国经济数据的校准模拟结果显示，稳定币通过削弱货币政策的有效性，放大了外生冲击对关键宏观经济变量的传导效应。然而，审慎监管——特别是针对稳定币与法定计价储备资产支持比率的监管（类似于银行流动性要求）——可作为稳定工具，在存在稳定币的情况下抑制波动性并增强宏观经济韧性。

title: A study on the impact of manufacturing and productive services agglomeration on two-way foreign direct investment: based on spatial econometric models
title_zh: 制造业与生产性服务业集聚对双向外商直接投资的影响研究：基于空间计量模型

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper takes China’s Yangtze River Delta region as a case study. Building upon Ellison, Gläeser, and Kerr (2007), it constructs an industrial agglomeration index and employs a more scientifically rigorous spatial econometric methodology to systematically examine the impact of synergistic agglomeration between manufacturing and business services on two-way foreign direct investment (FDI), along with its heterogeneity. Research confirms that, overall, the separate agglomeration of manufacturing and productive services significantly inhibits outward foreign direct investment (OFDI), whereas synergistic agglomeration exerts a positive effect on OFDI, with no significant impact on inward foreign direct investment (IFDI). The synergistic agglomeration of manufacturing and productive services primarily influences OFDI through the degree of government intervention and the sophistication of the labour market. The impact of manufacturing and productive services agglomeration on bilateral FDI exhibits significant heterogeneity across geographical location, transport conditions, urban political status, historical openness, and clan culture. By examining the relationship between manufacturing and productive services agglomeration and two-way FDI, this study bridges the interaction between industrial agglomeration and urban openness, offering insights for economic policy formulation at the meso-level.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国长三角地区为案例，在Ellison、Gläeser与Kerr（2007）研究基础上构建产业集聚指数，并采用更具科学严谨性的空间计量方法，系统考察制造业与商务服务业协同集聚对双向外商直接投资（FDI）的影响及其异质性。研究证实：整体而言，制造业与生产性服务业的单独集聚显著抑制对外直接投资（OFDI），而协同集聚则对OFDI产生正向促进作用，但对内向直接投资（IFDI）无显著影响。制造业与生产性服务业的协同集聚主要通过政府干预程度与劳动力市场成熟度影响OFDI。制造业与生产性服务业集聚对双向FDI的影响在地理区位、交通条件、城市政治地位、历史开放度及宗族文化层面呈现显著异质性。通过剖析制造业与生产性服务业集聚同双向FDI的关系，本研究架起了产业集聚与城市开放性的互动桥梁，为中观层面经济政策制定提供启示。

title: Do pensions enhance effort and selective retention?: Evidence from public schools
title_zh: 养老金能否提升工作努力与选择性留任？——来自公立学校的证据
title_primary: 养老金能否提升工作努力与选择性留任？——来自公立学校的证据
title_secondary: Do pensions enhance effort and selective retention?: Evidence from public schools
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Why do employers offer pensions? We empirically investigate two rationales, namely that they improve worker effort and selectively retain good workers. We test these hypotheses using rich administrative data on effort and output for public school teachers around the pension-eligibility threshold. When teachers cross the threshold, their effective compensation falls by over 50 percent of salary due to sharply reduced pension accruals. Standard economic models predict that this effective pay cut reduces teacher effort and output, but we observe no such decline. This suggests that yearly pension accruals do not meaningfully increase effort. Similarly, if pensions selectively retain better teachers, we would expect average teacher quality to decline when the retentive incentive disappears at the threshold. Instead, we find no change in workforce composition, suggesting pensions do not selectively retain higher-performing teachers around the threshold.
abstract_zh: 为什么雇主会提供养老金？我们通过实证研究探讨了两个理由，即养老金能提升员工努力程度并有选择性地留住优秀员工。我们利用围绕养老金资格门槛的公立学校教师的丰富行政数据，对努力程度和产出进行了测试。当教师跨越这一门槛时，由于养老金累积急剧减少，其有效薪酬下降超过工资的50%。标准经济模型预测，这种有效减薪会降低教师的努力程度和产出，但我们并未观察到此类下降。这表明年度养老金累积并未显著提升努力程度。同样，如果养老金能有选择性地留住更优秀的教师，我们预期当门槛处的保留激励消失时，平均教师质量会下降。然而，我们发现劳动力构成并无变化，这表明在门槛附近，养老金并未有选择性地留住表现更佳的教师。

title: Money Markets, Collateral, and Monetary Policy
title_zh: 货币市场、抵押品与货币政策
title_primary: 货币市场、抵押品与货币政策
title_secondary: Money Markets, Collateral, and Monetary Policy
authors: Fiorella De Fiore, Marie Hoerova, Ciaran Rogers, Harald Uhlig
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document dramatic changes in euro area interbank money markets during the financial and sovereign debt crises: unsecured borrowing declined across the euro area, while secured market haircuts on sovereign bonds increased, and bank borrowing from the European Central Bank rose in southern countries. We construct a quantitative general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic impact of these developments and the associated policy response. Our model features heterogeneous banks and sovereign bonds, secured and unsecured money markets, and a central bank. We compare a benchmark policy—the central bank providing collateralized lending to banks at haircuts lower than the market—with an alternative policy that maintains a constant central bank balance sheet. We show that the fall in output, investment, and capital would have been twice as high under the alternative policy.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了欧元区银行间货币市场在金融危机和主权债务危机期间的剧烈变化：欧元区无担保借贷普遍下降，主权债券的担保市场折扣率上升，而南部国家银行从欧洲中央银行的借款增加。我们构建了一个定量一般均衡模型，以评估这些变化及其相关政策应对的宏观经济影响。该模型包含异质性银行与主权债券、有担保与无担保货币市场，以及中央银行。我们将基准政策——中央银行以低于市场的折扣率向银行提供抵押贷款——与维持中央银行资产负债表不变的替代政策进行比较。研究表明，在替代政策下，产出、投资和资本的下降幅度将是基准政策的两倍。

official: 官方在线 2026-04-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: American economic historians generally believe that U.S. modern economic growth began before 1840, was broadly based, and the acceleration was gradual. These claims are treated as conjectures rather than solid conclusions because the census did not publish good economic data before 1840. But the earlier period was not a “statistical dark age,” as sometimes asserted. After 1817, systematic statistics on postal activity were available at the local level at high frequencies. These data shed light on the timing and sources of the onset of modern economic growth, the patterns of regional development, and the spread of a culture of communication.
abstract_zh: 美国经济史学家普遍认为，美国现代经济增长始于1840年之前，基础广泛且增速平缓。这些论断被视为推测而非确凿结论，因为1840年之前的人口普查并未发布可靠的经济数据。但早期阶段并非如某些观点所称的"统计黑暗时代"。1817年后，地方层面可获得高频次、系统性的邮政活动统计数据。这些数据揭示了现代经济增长的起始时间与驱动因素、区域发展模式以及通信文化的传播特征。

title: Psychological lock-in and institutional persistence: A mean-field model of confidence dynamics
title_zh: 心理锁定与制度持续性：信心动力学的平均场模型
title_primary: 心理锁定与制度持续性：信心动力学的平均场模型
title_secondary: Psychological lock-in and institutional persistence: A mean-field model of confidence dynamics
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We establish a mean-field stochastic framework for analyzing institutional lock-in driven by asymmetric belief updating. A continuum of agents update confidence levels s_tthrough success/failure experiences, with update functions F_S,F_Fexhibiting negativity bias: failures impact beliefs more strongly than successes of equal magnitude. Aggregate confidence I_tinfluences the success probability \pi(I_t), creating feedback between individual psychology and collective outcomes. We prove existence of stationary equilibria via Schauder’s fixed-point theorem on the space of probability measures \mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right), establishing compactness through Prokhorov’s theorem. Stability is characterized via spectral analysis of Fréchet derivatives in the bounded-Lipschitz metric, with operator decomposition into push-forward L_{\mu^\ast} and rank-one feedback R_{\mu^\ast} components. Under negativity bias and positive feedback, we establish multiplicity: generically three equilibria (low, middle, high) with stable-unstable-stable pattern. For escape dynamics from stable equilibria, we establish a large deviation principle on Skorokhod space D\left([0,\infty\right),\mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right)) with rate function determined by a quasi-potential computed via action functional minimization. Expected escape times scale as exp\left(N\cdot V\right) where N is population size and V is the quasi-potential, confirming exponential rarity: for calibrated parameters with N={10}^6 agents, escape times exceed {10}^{63,900} periods. We derive comparative statics for reform policy through optimal control: value function concavity implies optimal sequencing places high-success-probability reforms first. Material investments M and psychological interventions P exhibit strategic complementarity (\partial^2I^\ast/\partial M\partial P>0), verified through implicit function theorem analysis. Numerical verification with {10}^6 Monte Carlo simulations confirms all theoretical predictions, with robustness checks across alternative functional specifications. The framework provides a rigorous foundation for understanding institutional persistence as emerging from collective psychological dynamics rather than material coordination failures, with implications for development economics, political economy, and organizational change.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个平均场随机框架，用以分析由不对称信念更新所驱动的制度锁定现象。在此框架中，一个连续统的代理人通过成功/失败经历更新其信心水平s_t，更新函数F_S,F_F展现出负面偏差：同等强度的失败对信念的影响大于成功。总体信心I_t影响成功概率\pi(I_t)，从而在个体心理与集体结果之间形成反馈机制。我们通过Schauder不动点定理在概率测度空间\mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right)上证明了平稳均衡的存在性，并利用Prokhorov定理确立了紧致性。稳定性通过有界-Lipschitz度量下Fréchet导数的谱分析来刻画，其中算子分解为前推L_{\mu^\ast}与秩一反馈R_{\mu^\ast}两部分。在负面偏差与正反馈条件下，我们确立了多重性：一般存在三个均衡（低、中、高），呈现稳定-不稳定-稳定的模式。对于从稳定均衡的逃逸动态，我们在Skorokhod空间D\left([0,\infty\right),\mathcal{P}\left(\left[0,1\right]\right))上建立了大偏差原理，其速率函数由通过作用泛函最小化计算的准势决定。预期逃逸时间按exp\left(N\cdot V\right)缩放，其中N为总体规模，V为准势，从而确认了指数量级的稀有性：对于校准参数，当N={10}^6个代理人时，逃逸时间超过{10}^{63,900}个时期。我们通过最优控制推导了改革政策的比较静态分析：价值函数的凹性意味着最优排序应将高成功概率的改革置于首位。物质投资M与心理干预P表现出策略互补性（\partial^2I^\ast/\partial M\partial P>0），这一结论通过隐函数定理分析得到验证。基于{10}^6次蒙特卡洛模拟的数值验证确认了所有理论预测，并在不同函数设定下进行了稳健性检验。该框架为理解制度持续性源于集体心理动态而非物质协调失败提供了严谨基础，对发展经济学、政治经济学与组织变革具有启示意义。

title: The slow emergence of the rational investor: Grain markets and grain storage of rural estates in western Germany, eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries
title_zh: 理性投资者的缓慢崛起：18至19世纪初德国西部农村庄园的谷物市场与谷物储存
title_primary: 理性投资者的缓慢崛起：18至19世纪初德国西部农村庄园的谷物市场与谷物储存
title_secondary: The slow emergence of the rational investor: Grain markets and grain storage of rural estates in western Germany, eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries
authors: Matthias Hartermann, Ulrich Pfister, Friederike Scholten‐Buschhoff
official: 官方在线 2025-10-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop new datasets of monthly grain prices in 14 urban markets and of the storage and marketing of grain by 5 rural estates located in western Germany between the late seventeenth century and c . 1860. We explore whether observed patterns of monthly prices, sales, and storage of grain are consistent with the rational competitive storage model (RCSM). Results establish, first, that the crop year was divided into two seasons characterized by processing and marketing, respectively. Monthly prices of wheat during the marketing season (from February to summer) showed a pattern consistent with the rational competitive storage model. In the case of rye, which was a subsistence crop, a pattern of monthly prices consistent with the RCSM emerged only in the nineteenth century and was confined to urban markets. Second, grain price movements in spring and early summer predicted November prices, which implies the presence of inter‐annual arbitrage. Whereas carry‐over stocks held by rural estates partly served to provision a large household, tentative evidence suggests that some rural estates indeed also engaged in inter‐annual arbitrage, but they do not seem to have been able to earn a profit from holding carryover stocks.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了涵盖17世纪末至约1860年间德国西部14个城市市场的月度谷物价格数据集，以及5个乡村庄园的谷物储存与销售数据集。我们探究观察到的月度价格、销售及储存模式是否与理性竞争性储存模型（RCSM）相符。研究结果首先表明，农作物年度被划分为两个季节，分别以加工和销售为特征。小麦在销售季节（从二月至夏季）的月度价格模式与理性竞争性储存模型一致。对于作为生存作物的黑麦，其月度价格模式仅在19世纪才显现出与RCSM相符的特征，且仅限于城市市场。其次，春季及初夏的谷物价格变动能够预测十一月的价格，这暗示着存在跨年度套利行为。尽管乡村庄园持有的结转库存部分用于供应大型家庭所需，初步证据表明，一些乡村庄园确实也参与了跨年度套利，但他们似乎未能从持有结转库存中获利。

title: Climate finance and corporate ESG performance—evidence from China’s listed companies
title_zh: 气候金融与企业ESG表现——来自中国上市公司的证据
title_primary: 气候金融与企业ESG表现——来自中国上市公司的证据
title_secondary: Climate finance and corporate ESG performance—evidence from China’s listed companies
official: 官方在线 2025-10-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Climate finance, a crucial tool for advancing global sustainable development, is gaining attention because of its potential influence on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) outcomes. However, the research in this area is limited. This study empirically examines the impact of climate finance on corporate ESG performance using a sample of A-share listed companies from 2010 to 2023. The results indicate that climate finance significantly improves corporate ESG performance, which remains robust across multiple tests. This improvement is driven primarily by two mechanisms: Increased digital transformation and decreased agency costs. These positive effects are particularly evident in non-state-owned enterprises, large firms, companies operating in competitive and non-heavily polluting industries, and those located in the eastern region. Overall, this study highlights the positive influence of climate finance on corporate ESG performance and the mechanisms through which it operates, underscoring its role in strengthening corporate governance and advancing sustainable development. These findings provide valuable implications for corporate managers and policymakers.

title: Fortune's Formula or the Road to Ruin? The Generalized Kelly Criterion With Multiple Outcomes
title_zh: 财富公式还是毁灭之路？多结果下的广义凯利准则
title_primary: 财富公式还是毁灭之路？多结果下的广义凯利准则
title_secondary: Fortune's Formula or the Road to Ruin? The Generalized Kelly Criterion With Multiple Outcomes
official: 官方在线 2023-04-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: You can bet on an event where there are multiple possible winners but only one will actually win. At the odds offered, you think there may be multiple bets worth taking. How much do you place on each bet to maximize your expected utility? We describe how this problem can be solved for concave utility functions and illustrate the properties of the solution. The optimal betting strategy is more aggressive than strategies derived from considering each outcome separately such as the Kelly criterion. The strategy also recommends sometimes placing bets with negative expected returns because they act as hedges against losses on other bets. While this strategy maximizes the bettor's subjective expected utility, if betting odds incorporate a profit margin and reflect underlying probabilities correctly, then this more aggressive approach loses more money and results in lower realized utility.
abstract_zh: 你可以对一个存在多个潜在赢家、但最终只有一个会获胜的事件下注。根据给出的赔率，你认为可能存在多个值得投注的选择。那么，为了最大化你的期望效用，每个赌注应该下多少？我们描述了如何在凹效用函数下解决这一问题，并展示了该解的性质。最优投注策略比单独考虑每个结果得出的策略（如凯利准则）更为激进。该策略有时还建议投注期望收益为负的选项，因为它们可以起到对冲其他赌注损失的作用。尽管这一策略能最大化投注者的主观期望效用，但如果投注赔率包含了利润空间并正确反映了潜在概率，那么这种更激进的方法会导致更多亏损，并降低实际实现的效用。
